title: POST validate_headers: is_valid_message_id misses NUL byte check present in core validation.rs
description:
## What / Why
crates/reader/src/post/validate_headers.rs is_valid_message_id() checks for whitespace using is_ascii_whitespace() but does not explicitly check for NUL bytes (c == '\0'). The core validation in crates/core/src/validation.rs has an explicit NUL check. A Message-ID containing a NUL byte (e.g. '<foo\0bar@example.com>') would pass the reader POST validation but fail or behave unpredictably in downstream storage (SQLite text fields, LMDB keys, log entry bytes).

## Trigger → Bad Behavior
POST article with Message-ID: <foo\0bar@example.com> → passes validate_post_headers() in reader → reaches msgid_map.insert() → SQLite treats the string as truncated at NUL → the CID is stored under '<foo' → lookups by full ID fail → article is effectively unaddressable by msgid.

## Fix
Add c == '\0' to the inner.chars().any() check in is_valid_message_id in validate_headers.rs, matching the behavior in core/src/validation.rs.
